title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Bell
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：duty　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 duty 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my father ① took a duty that no man in the station would have chosen, and he said the taking was the whole of the winter. The ② duty, meaning the task and not the tax, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a duty, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unchosen.

Every ③ duty in that station had the same short bell at the end of it, and the ④ duty at the end, meaning the one they kept for the night watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A duty, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to take; my father said the taking is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the duty was the whole of the story, meaning the tax and not the task. The ⑥ duty, meaning the tax and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody pays and nobody questions; duty, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a task and a tax. He said the tax is the part they remember.

By 1954 the ⑦ duty had become a line in a roster, and the roster had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ duty of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one station and fourteen winters of taking; duty, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to take. She said the taking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ duty I remember is the one named in the roster, which ended in 1966 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ duty, my mother said in 1968, is the only one that improves by being taken; every duty, she said, is a tax that has agreed to look like a task. She said the tax was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 职责；责任（指那个站上承担过的那一项）
B. n. 职责；责任（指那项职责本身，与关税相对）
C. 固定搭配：take a duty 承担一项职责
D. n. 职责；责任（指留给夜班的那一项）
E. n. 职责；责任（抽象总称，指一个站上的值守之事）
F. n. 职责；责任（指值班表上写到、被列名的那一项）
G. n. 税；关税（指故事里人人都缴却无人质疑的那样东西）
H. n. 税（抽象总称，指人人都缴却无人质疑的那种东西）

items.q: took a duty that no man in the station would have chosen
The duty, meaning the task and not the tax
the duty was the whole of the story
the duty had become a line in a roster
The duty of the whole thing
A duty, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: take a duty 意为“承担一项职责”，1945 年父亲承担了一项站上没有一个人肯选的职责。
duty 意为“职责、责任”，指那项职责本身而不是关税，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
duty 意为“职责、责任”，指那个站上的每一项职责，每一项到头都有同一声短短的铃。
duty 意为“职责、责任”，指留给夜班的那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
duty 意为“税、关税”，指故事里人人都缴却无人质疑的那样东西，叔叔说这笔税就是那个故事的全部。
duty 意为“税”，指人人都缴却无人质疑的那种东西而不是那项职责，是故事里人人都缴、却无人质疑的东西。
duty 意为“职责、责任”，指值班表上写到、被列名的那一项，到 1954 年这项职责成了值班表里的一行。
duty 意为“职责、责任”，父亲一月写道，整件事的值守之事是一个站上和十四个冬天的承担。
duty 意为“职责、责任”，我记得的是值班表上列名的那一项，1966 年结束了，至今仍被说成站上最安静的一项。
duty 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，一项职责是唯一会因为被好好承担而变得更好的东西。
